ChemblDataSourceRoutingRule.description:
Routing rule retained for the public ChEMBL connector.

ChEMBL sources were registered before PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov routing
rules became a tagged union. Keep the persisted target identifier explicit so
existing sources remain readable and new registrations use the same contract.
ChemblDataSourceRoutingRule.title: ChemblDataSourceRoutingRule

ChemistrySavedSearchQuery.description: Versioned saved-search payload; the structure stays server-side, not in a URL.
ChemistrySavedSearchQuery.title: ChemistrySavedSearchQuery

DrugComparisonProfileRead.description: Complete, server-computed development profile for one compared drug.
DrugComparisonProfileRead.title: DrugComparisonProfileRead

DrugComparisonResult.description: Bounded batch response used by the human drug comparison workspace.
DrugComparisonResult.title: DrugComparisonResult

DrugProgramSearchResult.description: A paged, human-readable view of one drug's complete development set.
DrugProgramSearchResult.title: DrugProgramSearchResult

EpidemiologyLandscapeRead.description: Full-hit-set epidemiology statistics; missing values are explicit buckets.
EpidemiologyLandscapeRead.title: EpidemiologyLandscapeRead

similarity.description: Retriever ranking score; it is not normalized and is not a probability.
similarity.title: Similarity

NewsLandscapeRead.description: Full-hit-set news statistics; missing values are explicit buckets.
NewsLandscapeRead.title: NewsLandscapeRead

PatentLandscapeRead.description:
Full-hit-set patent statistics computed by the database for the applied query.

Buckets always cover the complete authorized result set, never the current page;
missing values are reported as explicit `__missing__` buckets instead of being
silently dropped.
PatentLandscapeRead.title: PatentLandscapeRead

RegulatoryLandscapeRead.description:
Full-hit-set regulatory statistics for the applied query; missing values are
explicit `__missing__` buckets and counts never come from the current page.
RegulatoryLandscapeRead.title: RegulatoryLandscapeRead

TargetDossierSummaryRead.description:
Server-computed target landscape counts over the complete authorized result set.

Counts are never derived from the truncated record collections returned alongside
them. Free-text source statuses are classified by an explicit versioned vocabulary
and anything outside it is reported as unclassified instead of being silently
bucketed.
TargetDossierSummaryRead.title: TargetDossierSummaryRead
